verdict.rationale: Jan documents an API reference for its local OpenAI-compatible server, covering GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions and POST /v1/messages, each with copy-pasteable curl examples and sample responses that run against localhost:1337. The reference is static, though: the docs say no try-it console, sandbox, or OpenAPI spec exists, and probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all returned 404. missing for 10: interactive try-it console or in-browser execution, downloadable OpenAPI spec, sandbox environment.
